title: Unnai Thedi
desc: Raghu travels to New Zealand with a friend and meets Malavika, whom he falls in love with. However, circumstances force them to part ways.

title: Veetula Raman Veliyila Krishnan
desc: Rajasekaran, a civil engineer, marries Jayalakshmi and moves to the city. Their peaceful life turns chaotic when their neighbour Subba Rao casts an evil eye on Jayalakshmi.

title: Thalayatti Bommaigal
desc: Mari, a rickshaw driver, finds an innocent child on the road and brings him home. He hires a lady caretaker, leading his lover to misunderstand and decide to leave him.

title: Janakiraman
desc: Two brothers remain sworn to bachelorhood. However, chaos arises when a man tries to get them married to his daughters.
